backup.production_rule: s117 (Lloyd 2026-11-11): a warning closes itself once it is addressed or expired (docs/s117/CONTRACT.md, QUIET_HOURS = 6). V22 (paid API credit used up) is raised only while the provider still has a non-probe call in the last 6 hours. Open system task power_poster_unread closes only when the poster is decided (read into app_settings.power_watch_state.images; there is no age rule, a still-unreadable poster stays reported) and low_stock closes only when nothing is at or under its reorder level, both with completion_note 'Closed automatically: <why>', from apply_verifier_run_v1 every hour. The active stock item Heater (Heatek) is renamed Kettle / Water Heater (owner decision 2026-11-11). Round 2 (owner: fix all): V10 checkouts_cleaned gets one day of grace after checkout and ignores mid_stay cleanings (get_missed_cleanings rule); the cleaner-fee ledger side of the KPI reconcile (V10 kpi_reconciled, V19 cleaner_fee) leaves out pay-ahead advances (external_ref cleanadv:) whose report is not linked yet and that are under 7 days old (held out for 7 days while the report is due; after that it counts again); app_settings api_caps omniroute-key cap goes 0.5 -> 0.15 to match the V16 advice. The orchestrator re-stamps restore_point and verified_at on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill is the house label for function bodies plus guarded data steps; no table, column, trigger or index changes. Four existing function bodies are replaced, each guarded by the md5 of the live body: run_system_verifier_v1 (s115, fed6e28a17b41ab980a7e8fd52fc9a9d) gains one extra condition in V22 (a non-probe call in the last 6 hours); apply_verifier_run_v1 (s115, a348d3acf2770e3773fce39bcb8e383b) gains one block that calls the new system_tasks_expire_v1 inside its own exception handler (a failure becomes a warning, never a failed verifier run); health_checks_core_v1 (s91, bfaa9cfc27f993c8f54a9b3d5ddcc579) has the checkouts_cleaned query changed (checkout < today - 1, mid_stay sessions do not count); kpi_recompute_v1 (s91, 33395271b45dc6289d93d5922603a65d) leaves unlinked cleanadv: ledger rows under 7 days old out of cleaner_fee_ledger (held out for 7 days while the report is due; after that it counts again). Two functions are new (api_usage_last_calls_v1 for the system-verifier lane W, system_tasks_expire_v1), both service_role only. All six have their grants restated (ML-21). Data: one inventory_items row is renamed, only when exactly one active row is called Heater (Heatek) and no row is called Kettle / Water Heater; the api_caps omniroute-key cap changes 0.5 -> 0.15 only from 0.5 (a missing row or entry is skipped with a notice); both are skipped with a notice on a rebuild without the data. Expected live effect: V22 credit_gone:gemini resolves at the next hourly run (nothing calls Gemini); the stale power_poster_unread task closes only once Power watch decides that poster (it stays open while the poster is unreadable); the low_stock task stays open while anything is at or under its reorder level (14 items are low today, so it does not close now); the Staff and admin lists show the Kettle / Water Heater name; V10 checkouts_cleaned drops the 2026-11-10 stay and still shows HM538AA4C4 (2026-08-24, a real missing report that ages out on 2026-11-22 or closes with a backfilled session); V10 kpi_reconciled and V19 2026-11 cleaner_fee stay balanced when a pay-ahead report is late; V16 omniroute-key stops advising once the real OmniRoute daily limit is also 0.15 (owner action in the OmniRoute dashboard). Tasks the sweep closes are not reopened by the rollback.
